Hi Tessa / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Voltix is excited to move from POC -> trial, and our execs asked for a simple mutual action plan they can review with ops/security. Can you share a lightweight MAP template and a proposed 30-day evaluation sprint outline?

High-level asks from our side:
- Clear acceptance criteria for success (latency, cost targets)
- Test data and redaction expectations
- Key stakeholders and decision gates (legal, security, infra)
- Proposed kickoff date in the first two weeks of January

If you can drop a doc and a short slide with a suggested timeline, we’ll route it internally and propose a kickoff slot.

Best,
Alex

Hi Alex —

Great to hear you want to move forward. I created a first-pass MAP prototype and a compact 30-day sprint slide deck. Links are below — I kept the MAP intentionally short (one page + ownership RACI) so leadership can scan quickly.

What I included in the MAP prototype:
- Goal: Validate production inference at 99th pct latency <= 250ms and per-token cost within agreed budget
- Owners: Voltix (infra, dataset), Redwood (runtime configuration, model variant), Joint (acceptance)
- Acceptance criteria: smoke test, throughput benchmark, UX sample set pass rate >= 90%
- Decision gates: security review, contract sign, pilot accept
- Risks & mitigations: data retention, KV cache sizing, fallback model plan

Proposed next steps:
1) You review the doc and drop any missing owners/criteria — we’ll update live
2) Book 45m kickoff (technical + stakeholder sync) — suggest Jan 10 or Jan 12
3) We’ll ship a runbook (week0) and a weekly checkpoint cadence for the 30-day sprint

Links / attachments:
- MAP: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_MAP_Prototype_v0.1
- Slides (30d sprint): attached as 30d-eval-sprint-slides.pptx

I attached the slide deck and a stub MAP doc (converted to Google Doc). If it looks good, Marissa can map acceptance criteria to your KPI sheet.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
Tessa.Morgan@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: MAP_Prototype_v0.1.gdoc (Google Doc link), 30d-eval-sprint-slides.pptx (pptx)

Alex —

Quick follow-up from the acceptance criteria perspective. I pulled a short checklist that maps to our MAP prototype; please call out any metric thresholds that are non-starters for Voltix.

Acceptance checklist (suggested):
- Performance: 99th pct latency <= 250ms for 1k rps steady-state during pilot
- Cost: target per-1k-token cost <= your internal threshold (please confirm)
- Data handling: no raw PII stored; redact before log ingest or use ephemeral keys
- Security: SOC2 evidence review complete and one operational audit log sample in week1
- UX: sample set of 50 representative prompts with human review pass rate >= 90%

I added two small templates to the MAP doc: a kickoff agenda (45m) and a week-by-week runbook table. I also attached a short list of SLA/security questions that legal typically asks — please have your security contact glance over it so we can put an owner on any open items.

Suggested meeting times for kickoff (PST):
- Mon Jan 10, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Jan 12, 14:00–14:45

If those don’t work, propose alternatives and Jonas will align infra availability.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: SLA_questions.pdf (pdf)
